Name: Eliakim
Summary: Eliakim, son of Hilkiah, was set over Hezekiah's household in Shebna's place and was one of the three officials who met the Assyrian officers at Jerusalem's wall.
KeyStory: Eliakim, Shebna, and Joah went out to hear the Rabshakeh at the conduit of the upper pool, then tore their clothes and reported his words to Hezekiah.
LifeLesson: Faithful service means carrying bad news honestly to the king and to God.
